
## Code Reviews

- When reviewing a pull request read the body of the pull request and identify the "Type of Work" and the "Topic". 
- Select the review criteria to be used from the secton below with the heading that matches the "Type of Work" and the "Topic".
- Review only the critera explicitly mentioned in the section.
- Place your findings in a table in the final review comment on the pull request rather than on comments on individual lines of code.
- Always mark your review as "Comment" rather than "Approve" or "Request Changes".

### Tutorial: HTML and CSS

- Review web-projects/first-website/index.html checking for the following content:
  - a descriptive title in the head.
  - the styles/styles.css file is linked in the head.
  - the head contains a font from to Google Fonts.
  - an h1 heading wtih the same title.
  - an img tag that displays an image and has descriptive alt text.
  - one or more p elements below the image.
  - an unordered list or ordered list element with at least 3 list items.
  - at least one link element.
- Review web-projects/first-website/styles/style.css checking that there are rules with element selectors for the following elements: h1, p, li, body, html.

### Extension: HTML and CSS

- Do not perform a review. Instead use the message "Extension: HTML and CSS does not yet have review criteria" as the final review comment on the pull request.
